_comment: Music stations for the Smart TV. This file is data - edit it freely, no
rebuild needed. Each entry needs name, url and genre.
url must be a DIRECT stream address (Icecast/Shoutcast/HLS), the same kind
Second Life parcel audio accepts - not a web page that contains a player.
A page url will silently fail to play.
No stations ship with the project on purpose: a stream address that has
gone stale makes the TV look broken. Add the ones you actually use, or add
them in the UI with the Add station button.
